+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+    const bool column0Valid = localColumn0 < columnWidth;
+    const bool column1Valid = localColumn1 < columnWidth;

+    double sum01 = 0.0;
+    double sum10 = 0.0;

+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }
+}

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }
+}

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),

+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }

+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+    if (row1Valid && column0Valid &&
+        (tileRow != tileColumn || localRow1 >= localColumn0)) {
+        matrix[(rowBase + localRow1) * n + columnBase + localColumn0] -= sum10;
+    }
+    if (row1Valid && column1Valid &&
+        (tileRow != tileColumn || localRow1 >= localColumn1)) {
+        matrix[(rowBase + localRow1) * n + columnBase + localColumn1] -= sum11;

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }
+}

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }
+}

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+                         localColumn0]

+    const bool column1Valid = localColumn1 < columnWidth;

+    double sum01 = 0.0;
+    double sum10 = 0.0;
+    double sum11 = 0.0;

+        if (row1Valid && column0Valid) {

+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +

+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {

+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+__global__ void updateTrailingTile(double* matrix, const size_t n,
+                                   const size_t trailingBase,
+                                   const int panelWidth,
+                                   const int trailingTileCount) {

+                         localColumn0]

+                         localColumn0]

+    const bool row0Valid = localRow0 < rowHeight;

+    const bool column1Valid = localColumn1 < columnWidth;

+    double sum10 = 0.0;

+        if (row1Valid && column1Valid) {

+        }

+        (tileRow != tileColumn || localRow0 >= localColumn0)) {
+        matrix[(rowBase + localRow0) * n + columnBase + localColumn0] -= sum00;
+    }
+    if (row0Valid && column1Valid &&

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }
+}

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+}  // namespace
+
+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }
+}

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+
+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {

+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;

+// A_ij -= A_ik * A_jk^T.

+__global__ void updateTrailingTile(double* matrix, const size_t n,
+                                   const size_t trailingBase,
+                                   const int panelWidth,

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,

+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),

+            return false;

+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",

+            cleanup();

+        if (trailingBase < n) {

+            const size_t trailingTileCount =

+__global__ void updateTrailingTile(double* matrix, const size_t n,

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const size_t elementCount = n * n;
+    const size_t bytes = elementCount * sizeof(double);
+    double* deviceMatrix = nullptr;
+    int* deviceFailurePivot = nullptr;
+
+    auto cleanup = [&]() {
+        if (deviceFailurePivot != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceFailurePivot);
+        }
+        if (deviceMatrix != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceMatrix);
+        }
+    };
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceMatrix, bytes),
+                         "allocating device matrix") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(&deviceFailurePivot, sizeof(int)),
+                         "allocating pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(deviceMatrix, A.data(), bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                         "copying matrix to device") ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMemset(deviceFailurePivot, 0xff, sizeof(int)),
+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    const size_t tileCount = (n + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {
+        const size_t diagonalBase = tile * kTileSize;
+        const int diagonalWidth = static_cast<int>(std::min(
+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));
+
+        factorDiagonalTile<<<1, kTileSize>>>(
+            deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, diagonalWidth,
+            deviceFailurePivot);
+
+        int failurePivot = -1;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(&failurePivot, deviceFailurePivot,
+                                        sizeof(failurePivot),
+                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                             "factoring diagonal tile")) {
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+        if (failurePivot >= 0) {
+            printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
+                   failurePivot);
+            cleanup();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const size_t trailingBase = diagonalBase + diagonalWidth;
+        if (trailingBase < n) {
+            const size_t remaining = n - trailingBase;
+            const size_t trailingTileCount =
+                (remaining + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize;
+            const int trailingTiles = static_cast<int>(trailingTileCount);
+
+            solvePanelTile<<<trailingTiles, kTileSize>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, diagonalBase, trailingBase, diagonalWidth);
+
+            updateTrailingTile<<<dim3(trailingTiles, trailingTiles),
+                                 dim3(kUpdateBlockSize, kUpdateBlockSize)>>>(
+                deviceMatrix, n, trailingBase, diagonalWidth, trailingTiles);
+        }
+    }
+
+    const dim3 zeroBlock(16, 16);
+    const dim3 zeroGrid(static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16),
+                        static_cast<unsigned int>((n + 15) / 16));
+    zeroUpperTriangle<<<zeroGrid, zeroBlock>>>(deviceMatrix, n);
+
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), deviceMatrix, bytes,
+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
+                         "copying result to host")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    cleanup();
     return true;
 }

+// Blocked, right-looking Cholesky decomposition on the GPU. The matrix is
+// overwritten in row-major order with L, where A = L * L^T.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {
+    if (n == 0) {

+    }

+        }

+                         "allocating pivot status")) {

+                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),

+                         "initializing pivot status")) {
+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }

+    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < tileCount; ++tile) {

+            static_cast<size_t>(kTileSize), n - diagonalBase));

+                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),

+        cleanup();
+        return false;
+    }

+__global__ void zeroUpperTriangle(double* matrix, const size_t n) {
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y +
+                       threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t column = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                          threadIdx.x;
+    if (row < n && column < n && column > row) {
+        matrix[row * n + column] = 0.0;
+    }

+bool reportCudaError(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == cudaSuccess) {
+        return true;
+    }
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation,
+            cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    return false;
+}
